verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents an official MCP server, remote-hosted or local, that connects AI agents like Claude or Cursor to account data for tasks up to 'flow performance reports'. It also states that people and agents can read, write, and act on Klaviyo data headlessly through its public APIs and MCP server, which supports pulling data for dashboards and performance analysis. missing for 10: explicit evidence of reading audiences (lists/segments) and campaign-level performance results, no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent reporting quality.
